title: IBAN Attestation for Individuals
description: IBAN attestation for natural persons: confirms an individual's ownership of an IBAN, with bank account (including optional account token), account ownership and account provider attributes.

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the IBAN Attestation for Individuals.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the issuer that issued the credential

issuance_date.description: Date and possibly time of issuance

expiry_date.description: Date and possibly time of credential expiration

authentic_source_id.description: EUID of the data providing entity

authentic_source_name.description: Name of the data providing entity

account_name.description: Name of the account, generated by the bank or customized by the owner

IBAN.description: International Bank Account Number, as defined in ISO 13616:2020

account_currency.description: Currency code used of the account, as defined in ISO 4217:2015

account_usage.description: Specification about the private or professional usage of the account

bank_account_token.description: Attributes representing the bank account token

account_token_number.description: Account token, a surrogate for the IBAN that can be specific to the device and wallet; formatted like an IBAN as defined in ISO 13616:2020.

masked_account_number.description: Masked account number to which the bank account token is linked.

token_attributes.description: JSON formatted list of token attributes and values

owner_name.description: Name of the natural person owning the account

parties.description: List of parties involved in the account ownership

full_name.description: Full name of the physical person

provider_name.description: Name of the financial institution providing the account

provider_country.description: Alpha-2 country code, as defined in ISO 3166-1, of the provider country or territory

BIC.description: BIC or SWIFT code, as defined in ISO 9362, of the financial institution

clearing_number.description: Clearing number, only used in some countries, of the identification of the financial institution

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
